# Orcha

> Orcha is the open-source runtime for multi-protocol AI agent orchestration.
> One natural-language goal is decomposed into a dependency-ordered agent DAG,
> routed across MCP, A2A, ACP, and COMPUTER_USE protocol handlers, and
> rendered as a CanvasKit dashboard instead of chat text. The full stack runs
> with `PAYMENT_MODE=mock` and no closed-service dependency.

Pattern adopted from docs.traycer.ai/llms.txt — an index for LLMs and coding
agents to discover the public docs in this repo without crawling everything.

## Start here

- [README](../README.md): project overview, quickstart, architecture diagram

- [ROADMAP](../ROADMAP.md): milestone trajectory
